fields.notes: DSI v1.01.00 is a protocol-layer specification; all electrical / timing constraints flow down from D-PHY. The only DSI-specific physical requirement of consequence is host-vs-peripheral LP clock frequency ratio (67%..150%) and the T_INIT power-up timing chain. EoTp enable/disable is also an implementation requirement that must be exposed (no normative mechanism specified).

pcb_constraints.AC_coupling: NOT used — D-PHY is DC-coupled differential
pcb_constraints.ESD_protection_class: HBM 2 kV minimum (Class 2); diodes placed close to connector

pad_constraints.shared_HS_LP_pad: Same Dp/Dn pair carries both modes; lane-state controller arbitrates

sdc_floorplan_hints.Clock_Lane_PLL_placement: Close to host pads; minimize jitter.
sdc_floorplan_hints.Per_lane_delay_line_placement: Close to peripheral pads; programmable for deskew.
sdc_floorplan_hints.Sync_hunter_placement: Peripheral side; pipelined to meet Clock-Lane DDR rate.
sdc_floorplan_hints.BTA_LP_TX_LP_RX_arbiter_placement: On bidirectional Data Lane 0 only — must coexist on the same pad pair.

fields.notes_on_dsi_scope: DSI v1.01.00 §1.1 explicitly declares electrical / physical specifications out of scope; PCB constraints come from D-PHY v0.90.00.

pcb_constraints_inherited_from_d_phy.AC_coupling: NOT used — D-PHY is DC-coupled differential
pcb_constraints_inherited_from_d_phy.ESD_protection_class: HBM 2 kV minimum (Class 2); diodes placed close to connector

dsi_specific_implementation_constraints.peripheral_T_INIT_accuracy: R-C timer with ±30% accuracy is acceptable (§5.7).
dsi_specific_implementation_constraints.host_T_INIT_MASTER_lower_bound: ≥ t_POR + T_INIT_SLAVE + T_INTERNAL_DELAY of the peripheral (§5.7).
dsi_specific_implementation_constraints.EoTp_enable_disable_means: Implementation-specific; must exist on every v1.01-compliant device for backward compatibility (§8.8.2, §10.9).

extraction_hints: Look for floorplan, area, power, timing constraints.
